SELECT p.name, SUM(io.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items io JOIN products p ON io.product_id = p.id WHERE io.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'not_paid') AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90)) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT SUM(amount_cents) / 100.0 AS total_dollars FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS current_staff FROM employees

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'won' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount_cents) AS win_percentage FROM opportunities WHERE closed_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(months => 12) AND closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT SUM(headcount_capacity) AS total_headcount_capacity FROM office_locations
SELECT COUNT(*) AS waiting_claims FROM expense_reports WHERE status = 'submitted' AND submitted_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90)
SELECT c.channel, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT l.converted_org_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS percentage FROM campaigns c JOIN leads l ON c.id = l.campaign_id GROUP BY c.channel

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.id) AS wins, SUM(o.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS total_value FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps s ON o.rep_id = s.id WHERE o.stage = 'won' AND o.closed_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 180) AND o.closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY s.region

SELECT c.name AS campaign_name, COUNT(e.event_type) AS email_opens FROM campaigns c JOIN email_events e ON c.id = e.campaign_id WHERE e.event_type = 'opened' AND e.occurred_at >= '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY email_opens DESC LIMIT 2;

SELECT departments.name, COUNT(DISTINCT employees.id) AS current_employees FROM employees JOIN departments ON employees.department_id = departments.id WHERE employees.hired_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY departments.name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'won' THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(amount_cents) AS win_percentage FROM opportunities WHERE closed_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(months => 12) AND closed_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT SUM(mrr_cents) / 100.0 AS mrr_dollars FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('active', 'past_due')
SELECT plan_tier, SUM(mrr_cents) / 100.0 AS mrr_dollars FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('active', 'past_due') GROUP BY plan_tier

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS churned_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'canceled' AND canceled_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND canceled_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS plan_changes FROM subscription_events WHERE event_type IN ('upgraded', 'downgraded') AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90)
SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS redemption_count FROM coupon_redemptions GROUP BY code ORDER BY redemption_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN plan_tier = 'enterprise' THEN mrr_cents ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(mrr_cents) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' AND started_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_unpaid FROM invoices WHERE issued_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 90) AND issued_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT SUM(mrr_cents) / 100.0 AS mrr_dollars FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('active', 'past_due')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets, priority FROM support_tickets WHERE assigned_agent_id IS NULL GROUP BY priority
SELECT team, AVG(score) AS avg_score FROM csat_surveys AS cs JOIN support_tickets AS st ON cs.ticket_id = st.id JOIN support_agents AS sa ON st.assigned_agent_id = sa.id GROUP BY team

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY category

SELECT AVG(T2.resolution_time - T1.created_at) AS avg_hours, T2.priority FROM support_tickets AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT ticket_id, MAX(resolution_time) AS resolution_time FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY ticket_id) AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ticket_id GROUP BY T2.priority
SELECT o.name, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM organizations o JOIN support_tickets st ON o.id = st.org_id WHERE st.status IN ('open', 'pending') GROUP BY o.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT t2.team, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t3.id) AS percentage FROM support_tickets AS t1 INNER JOIN support_agents AS t2 ON t1.assigned_agent_id = t2.id INNER JOIN csat_surveys AS t3 ON t1.ticket_id = t3.id WHERE t3.score IN (4, 5) GROUP BY t2.team
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending') AND created_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30) AND created_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 7) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS active_customers FROM organizations WHERE country = 'United States'
SELECT role, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY role
SELECT COUNT(*) AS revoked_api_keys FROM api_keys WHERE revoked_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 30)

SELECT ip_country, COUNT(*) AS successful_logins FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 7) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY ip_country

SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS sent, COUNT(CASE WHEN read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS read, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN read_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS read_percentage FROM notifications GROUP BY kind

SELECT o.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.api_key_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ar.api_key_id) AS failed_percentage FROM api_requests_daily ar JOIN organizations o ON ar.api_key_id = o.id WHERE ar.request_date <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY o.name ORDER BY failed_percentage DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.key, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT cu.org_id) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS percentage FROM feature_usage_daily cu INNER JOIN features f ON cu.feature_id = f.id INNER JOIN organizations o ON cu.org_id = o.id WHERE cu.usage_date >= date_trunc('month', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - make_interval(days => 30) AND cu.usage_date <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY f.key ORDER BY percentage DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM login_events WHERE success AND occurred_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00' - make_interval(days => 7) AND occurred_at <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-05 12:00:00+00';
